notes.title: Midsummer Sale & Hotfix
notes.notes:
Morning doggers, here's a little somethin' for ya!

STREET DOG LEGEND will be on sale for 10 days to celebrate peak hot-dog season. Go ahead and tell your friends to sling dogs for 25% off - it's a STEAL!



Today also brings a small hotfix for some tiny issues in the game.

— Permit container is hidden after all permits purchased and /or on day 28 in story mode

— Can no longer visit a certain somebody on day 28 in story mode

— Added a slight buffer period when making wrong turns in the skate minigame before you lose health

— Fixed some typos with bistro regulars

notes.title: EXPLORATION Update 1.1 is live!
notes.notes:
Thanks to the support of the Street Dog Legend community, we are releasing our first major update! Jam-packed with new features, new areas, new achievements and more, Update 1.1 gives Tony Dogger more to do, more to see and more ways to spend money! 


Exploration
All work and no play makes Tony Dogger miserable. Take some time out of your busy day slingin’ street dogs and explore five unique locations throughout New Frankfurt. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629738/b7b1196c0e3ad1792a969d12066ef7b537acb9e4.gif"]

Bodega: Support local business in New Frankfurt! Swing by your neighborhood bodega and peruse four slots of rotating items that will modify your workday — raise prices, improve customer patience, squirt sauce faster and more! And don’t forget to talk to the shopkeep, he’s a workin’ stiff just like you. 

Bistro: Relax and unwind at the Bistro with a “Slow-da,” to slow down your workday, or gulp a “Quick-cola” to speedrun through your shift! While you’re enjoying a drink, chat with a rotating roster of Supah Street Dog regulars — learn about their lives. Do they also have hopes, dreams, fears?

Casino: Like any red-blooded New Frankfurtian, Tony Dogger loves to gamble away his hard-earned money. Win big (or lose it all (pfft, yeah right)) at blackjack, slots, and horse races. 

Gym: Carting around boxes of raw hotdogs and wholesale-quantities of condiments isn’t enough exercise for a true dogger — you gotta PUMP IRON! Work out at the gym with three minigames that will increase Tony’s maximum energy, a new stat that allows him to explore more locations in a single day! 

Stock Exchange: No one involved in developing Street Dog Legend understands how the stock market works — and neither does Tony Dogger! Visit the New Frankfurt Stock Exchange to invest in leading companies in the hotdog industries. Watch that line go up (and down)! Make money! 



Cosmetic Magazine
Shrewd street cart operators can end up with more money than they know what to do with. A new magazine allows Tony Dogger to spend cash on optional cosmetic upgrades to his apartment. Want to live a life of luxury in a swanky pad? Spend money. Want to live in a filthy, rat-infested, wallpaper-peeling tenement? Spend money!!!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629738/a67586a8355b3a04f83337f8ef1092ab437d4a67.gif"]


Undo Button
A real street-dogger doesn’t need to learn from their mistakes, they’re already perfect! Now you can right-click on a hotdog at any step in the process and “undo” the previous addition. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629738/27992a0c64cedbf071350c1192214913a3654811.gif"]


New Achievements and Freeplay Goal
With new updates come new achievements! Let the world (or just your Steam friends) know that you are putting in the hours to build up your Street Dog empire! There is also a new freeplay goal of becoming SUPER LEGEND … but we won't spoil it.




Bug Fixes
This update also includes the following bug fixes:

— Reworked hot dog "scoring" so that sauce errors are considered worse than bun errors. Now, incorrect dogs will replace their more "accurate" order item

— Removed secret letter from Freeplay mode

— Fixed bug where gala dialogue would appear in Freeplay mode

— Fixed typos & continuity errors on days 18 and 28

— Fixed certain character in one ending not remembering having met you




What's next? 
Thanks for reading everything so far … as a little reward, here’s a bit of what we have planned for our next update, themed around THE MEDIA. 

This update will include: 

A functional television featuring a new program every day.

A pocket radio to switch up the music during your shift at the hotdog cart.

A new “zine” from a familiar group. 

We’re still chock-full of ideas for more content including new branching story paths and unique endings but the development team is taking some time to work on individual projects and refresh ourselves before we dive into the next update!

  

Remember that the best way to stay up-to-date on everything Street Dog is to join the official STREET DOG LEGEND Discord. 


Thanks again for all the support! 

Dog on, friends!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3.0
notes.notes:
Good afternoon to all hot dogs <3 And to everyone else... hi... I guess...

Here's a few fixes and adjustments ahead of our big 1.1 update:
— Raised hot dog prices by $0.50
— Raised base franchise earnings from $75 to $100
— Raised odds of someone ordering a dog with sauerkraut by 0.25%
— Reduced odds of INFINI-BURGER customers placing larger-sized orders

— Included some new logic in the day 0 tutorial that should account for common beginner errors
— Increased the size of the "rat poison zone" slightly
— Added [spoiler]"THE PARK"[/spoiler] label to [spoiler]the park[/spoiler] contract photo to clear up any confusion
— Added a hint when the [spoiler]rat hole first appears[/spoiler]

— Fixed issue with "notoriety" not resetting if quitting from main menu & immediately continuing
— Disabled accessing a certain secret when the Prompt window is open
— Fixed a logic error for the Day 12 cutscene
— Fixed a small typo in Meet'N'Date

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.2.1
notes.notes:
— Clarified the "Freeplay Mode" description
— Fixed issue where map could be opened during cutscenes
— Fixed issue with speedrun timer displaying incorrect time upon finishing the game
— Fixed issue with a certain "secret" persisting across saves when starting a new game from main menu

notes.title: Patch v1.0.2.0
notes.notes:
STREET DOG LEGEND had an incredible week, with lots of streamers trying out the game, \tens\ of new users, and we even reached enough reviews to earn us a little "Positive" on our store page. YAY!!! Thank you for all the support. Please keep the reviews coming if you like the game <3

Join the official STREET DOG LEGEND discord

Let's get into the patch notes:
— Lowered the price of fancy sauces to $200. Now you can get saucin' a little sooner
— Added a "pointer" to the notification on Day 1 so players will have a better chance of noticing their new magazine. So now, there's the letter, the prompt notification, and a pointer. If anyone else playing somehow misses the magazine, I'm officially blaming you - sorry!
— Clarified two secret clues, including making a "6" more six-like
— Fixed cutscene typos & errors on Days 8, 12, 22, 24, and 29
— Fixed issue where franchising reminder shows up more than once across multiple days
— Removed older "laptop open" sounds
— Texture compression was adjusted to a new format, which should reduce the game's file size back to ~300MB

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.1.2
notes.notes:
HAPPY ONE WEEK ANNIVERSARY TO STREET DOG LEGEND!


We have sold over 50 copies and have over 100 new wishlists. This kind of global financial success was unimaginable to us... we are so grateful for the support and we are so happy people are enjoying the game!


To celebrate, we have launched an official STREET DOG LEGEND discord server! 


The server is a little quiet right now, but if you're interested in discussing different story paths, speedrunning strategies, or offering suggestions for future updates, this is the place to do so! Just click the link above to join :)



If you've enjoyed the game and would like to support us, PLEASE leave a Steam review! We will love you forever and ever and ever and ever and- well, you get it.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629738/5cb9ca57035c813a29d5a307e9ffe4222914a616.jpg"]
Now, let's get into the latest update!


Here's some new accessibility changes:

— Added a pickle icon to the relish bottles to help people with Red/Green colorblindness distinguish between them better

— Increased the contrast to grilled buns & "special" hot dogs 



And here's some additional hotfix notes:

— Fixed the "Order Failure" sound playing at the end of each day

— Compressed more textures to lessen the VRAM load and hopefully address the rare lag issue we've seen on some streams of the game

— Adjusted the difficulty of EPIC STICK FIGHT, it is now slightly easier (but still epic)

— Added a CTA for steam reviews after quitting to main menu (this reminder can be disabled)

— Added a main menu button for the discord server



One final request: We've seen one instance of the main menu hot dog going absolutely crazy. So far this seems very, very rare, but if anyone else encounters the issue, please use the "Bug Report" button in the options menu, and let us know what your computer's specs are and if there are any steps to recreate the issue. Thank you!

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.1.1
notes.notes:
We've had a big influx of new players and new wishlists overnight - another special thanks to all you legends out there :D 

Another big thanks goes out to @itswill for trying out the game on his Twitch stream, and to @jcubed100 for making our first ever YouTube playthrough! 

This hotfix addresses some pretty spoiler heavy stuff that affected some gameplay and story progression. Notes below:
— Fixed issue where Start Menu music wouldn't loop. Yippie!
— Fixed issue where contracts would mistakenly auto-complete after serving any following customer a "special" hot dog
— Fixed issue where savescumming before a work day started would trigger the work timer in the apartment
— Fixed issue where game would save past the gala, which was never intended. Continuing on previous saves past day 29 may result in bugs, I recommend starting a new game on either Story or Freeplay mode if you wish to keep playing!
— Fixed typos for some dialogue and a clue in a secret area
— Adjusted odds of "special" customers appearing, they previously appeared a little too often
— Implemented safety check for a frame perfect bug that involves a pack of hot dogs and closing the cabinet. If someone else encounters this issue, please submit a bug report detailing steps to recreate!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Happy Friday! Thank God It's Hot Dog! God, Freakin' Mondays - Don't you hate them? Good thing it's not Monday - it's Friday! Which is awesome, by the way.

Here's a big patch of fixes for STREET DOG LEGEND to round out launch week! Huge thanks again to everyone who has played so far <3 Your feedback means so much, and it makes us happy that people care enough to let us know when there are issues. 

Before I get into the patch notes, I'd also like to mention that there's bigger content updates on the way - more cart upgrades, more minigames, more characters, and even newer content we don't want to spoil. So keep an eye out, version 1.1 will be HUGE!!! 

Now, here's the patch notes for version 1.0.1

MAJOR FIXES
– Fixed a major economy bug where customers paid twice for each order. At the expense of the citizens of New Frankfurt and their wallets, all of your playthroughs have been making BANK! No more! Now, customers only pay once. Sorry to the crapitalists, but this is only fair.

– Adjusted the pricing of Hot Dogs, and the bonus cash received with further upgrades. Upgrade progression should feel more natural and challenging. Those looking to relax more can still earn double money by enabling "Chill Mode" in the accessibility settings.

– Fixed steam overlay issues on MacOS - Achievements should now properly trigger for those users! The issue involved application codesigning.

MINOR FIXES
– Fixed a bug where players could cheat their previous health inspection by quitting / continuing 
– Fixed a minor dialogue issue on day 18
– Fixed bug where infini-burger grill upgrade didn't upgrade the grill (sorry)
– Adjusted inifini-burger economy so that it gets crazier much faster and is less boring
– Added additional hints towards some secrets in the game... I'll say no more!

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.0.3
notes.notes:
Just a couple more tweaks today! 

— Clarified some dialogue on Days 12, 16, and 18
— Fixed issue where "Disable BG Movement" option wasn't persistent
— Fixed a rare bug where the happiness meter would trigger a day failure while inactive
— Disabled background artwork processing when background isn't visible to help reduce lag on some systems
— Applied higher compression to cart & background textures to reduce lag on systems with limited VRAM


One request: if anyone experiences lag in either the Park or Downtown, please submit a bug report with your computer specs. It seems this lag issue is rare but I'd like to identify it further :)

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
Evening, doggers! Thank you for such positive feedback so far <3 If you're enjoying the game and would like to support us more, the best thing you can do is leave a review on Steam!

Some additional smaller fixes for tonight:
— Fixed bug where certain unlock purchase would not refresh if already unlocked
— Fixed some hidden achievements triggering later than expected
— Fixed a particle effect that failed to stop emitting
— Fixed a typo on Day 20
— Adjusted the probability of a certain, secret-path cart occurrence
— Adjusted bun grill R.O.I. and increased the "score" deduction for failing to get grilled bun orders correct
